task_instance: Capture a sample conversation about choosing PostgreSQL over MongoDB/DynamoDB for an orders service into a structured 'decision' page (title, status, owner, date, tags, alternatives, rationale) in the team's Notion decision-log database, linking back to the source conversation.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is a structured page created and linked inside Notion, produced via Notion MCP tools (notion-search, notion-fetch, notion-create-pages, notion-update-page) as specified in the SKILL.md workflow. The task instructions explicitly forbid calling any connector/MCP tools including mcp__Notion__*. There is no non-Notion fallback that satisfies the skill's stated intent (writing into a Notion database with proper schema/properties and relations) -- a local Markdown file is not the deliverable the skill promises. I was able to draft the extracted/structured content locally (facts, decision, alternatives, rationale, owner, status, date, tags) as evidence the content-structuring portion of the skill is feasible, but could not perform the actual Notion page creation/linking step, which is the skill's reason for existing.
evidence: Created /tmp/claude-0/.../scratchpad/exec_fresh/openai__skills__notion-knowledge-capture/sample_conversation.md (raw source conversation) and drafted_decision_page.md (structured decision-log entry with Status/Owner/Date/Tags/Context/Decision/Alternatives considered/Rationale/Links sections, matching the schema the skill's reference/decision-log-database.md would require). This demonstrates the extraction-and-structuring step (Workflow step 3) is achievable, but step 4 ('Create/update in Notion' via Notion:notion-create-pages') requires the mcp__Notion__* tools, which are explicitly disallowed by the safety rules for this exercise. No workaround was attempted, per instructions to stop and record the blocker rather than work around it.
